text: Hiya, I'm not sure if this is a silly thing to be texting about at this hour, perdón. I'm a foster carer and I've only had the baby since Tuesday so I don't know her normal yet if you know what I mean. She's a girl, 5 months old. I took her temperature about twenty minutes ago and it was 39.5, so I did it again with the other thermometer because I thought ah sure that can't be right, and it said 39.5 again. Dios mío, I've done plenty of placements but never one this small, so I'm second guessing myself. My mam always said not to be bothering doctors over a bit of a temperature but she's tiny and the social worker said ring the nurse line if in doubt, so here I am. Lo siento if this is nothing, I'd just rather ask. Is that number a worry for a baby her age? Should I be bringing her somewhere tonight or is it ok to keep an eye on her here? Gracias, really
